notes:
Founder-led startup (Ava Brooks, Founder/CTO). Prototype: VSCode plugin + Slack bot for dev ergonomic code completions and in-app assistant. Currently on OpenAI for generation and Anthropic for safety checks. Primary ask: straightforward hosted pricing that is predictable at SMB scale; wants simple per-month estimate for 50k and 100k tokens/day.

Key requirements/asks:
- Low friction self-serve onboarding (already signed up, created API key).
- Clear price per 1k tokens + sample monthly bill scenarios (no hidden surcharges).
- Comparison to OpenAI/Anthropic: effective per-token pricing, model footprint (gpt-like vs Claude-like), and fallback behavior when rate-limited.
- Streaming responses for code completions and low-latency chat (p95 target ~300ms for short prompts).
- Ability to pick model family and pin versions; open to quantized variants if latency/cost tradeoff makes sense.
- No immediate SOC2 requirement; wants SSO/SAML readiness and audit logging for future.
- Data residency not required today — public cloud ok.

Founder comments: 'We need something predictable — last month OpenAI cost spiked during our internal load test. If Redwood can show a better cost per completion and an easy way to route cheaper models for non-critical calls, we can migrate the production traffic.'

Sales posture: early-discovery, price-sensitive, heavy focus on simple TCO and migration story. SE action items: produce 2 price scenarios, include burst/overage behavior, show fallback routing example (gen->cheaper model) and latency expectations.
